sql.list:
WITH filtered_content AS (
  SELECT c.case_id, c.target_id AS post_id, c.status, c.priority, c.assigned_to, c.report_count,
         c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.latest_reported_at AS reported_at, p.author_id,
         DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(p.content, 4000, 1) AS content,
         NVL(ps.likes_count, 0) AS likes_count_post, NVL(ps.retweets_count, 0) AS retweets_count,
         NVL(ps.replies_count, 0) AS replies_count
  FROM n_moderation_cases c JOIN n_posts p ON p.post_id = c.target_id
  JOIN n_users u ON u.user_id = p.author_id
  LEFT JOIN n_post_stats ps ON ps.post_id = p.post_id
  WHERE c.target_type = 'post' AND (:post_id IS NULL OR c.target_id = :post_id)
    AND (:status IS NULL OR c.status = :status)
    AND (:priority IS NULL OR c.priority = :priority)
    AND (:reason IS NULL OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM n_moderation_reports r
      WHERE r.target_type = 'post' AND r.target_id = c.target_id AND r.reason = :reason
    ))
    AND (:q IS NULL OR INSTR(LOWER(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(p.content, 4000, 1)), LOWER(:q)) > 0
         OR INSTR(LOWER(u.username), LOWER(:q)) > 0 OR INSTR(LOWER(u.display_name), LOWER(:q)) > 0)
    AND (:date_range = 'all'
         OR :date_range = 'today' AND c.latest_reported_at >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
         OR :date_range = 'yesterday' AND c.latest_reported_at >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 1 AND c.latest_reported_at < TRUNC(SYSDATE)
         OR :date_range = 'week' AND c.latest_reported_at >= SYSTIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '7' DAY
         OR :date_range = 'month' AND c.latest_reported_at >= SYSTIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '30' DAY)
), ranked AS (
  SELECT f.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN :sort = 'most_reports' THEN report_count END DESC,
    CASE WHEN :sort = 'most_engagement' THEN likes_count_post + retweets_count + replies_count END DESC,
    CASE WHEN :sort = 'oldest' THEN reported_at END ASC,
    CASE WHEN :sort <> 'oldest' THEN reported_at END DESC,
    CASE WHEN :sort = 'oldest' THEN case_id END ASC, case_id DESC
  ) AS rn FROM filtered_content f
)
SELECT NVL(u.user_id, 0) AS user_id, u.username, u.avatar_url, u.display_name, u.bio, u.location, u.website,
       u.is_verified, us.followers_count, us.following_count, us.posts_count, us.likes_count,
       'offline' AS online_status, CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS last_seen_at,
       CASE WHEN u.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN fn_get_user_relationship(:viewer_id, u.user_id) END AS relation,
       r.case_id, r.post_id, r.content, r.status, r.priority, r.assigned_to, r.report_count,
       TO_CHAR(FROM_TZ(r.created_at, SESSIONTIMEZONE) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"') AS created_at, TO_CHAR(FROM_TZ(r.updated_at, SESSIONTIMEZONE) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"') AS updated_at,
       TO_CHAR(FROM_TZ(r.reported_at, SESSIONTIMEZONE) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"') AS reported_at,
       r.likes_count_post, r.retweets_count, r.replies_count, t.total
FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM filtered_content) t
LEFT JOIN ranked r ON r.rn BETWEEN :start_row AND :end_row
LEFT JOIN n_users u ON u.user_id = r.author_id
LEFT JOIN n_user_stats us ON us.user_id = r.author_id
ORDER BY r.rn
sql.reports:
SELECT r.report_id, r.target_type, r.target_id, r.reporter_user_id, r.reason, r.description, r.evidence_url,
       r.status, r.priority, r.handled_by,
       TO_CHAR(FROM_TZ(r.created_at, SESSIONTIMEZONE) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"') AS created_at, TO_CHAR(FROM_TZ(r.updated_at, SESSIONTIMEZONE) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"') AS updated_at,
       TO_CHAR(FROM_TZ(r.resolved_at, SESSIONTIMEZONE) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"') AS resolved_at, 0 AS total
FROM n_moderation_reports r WHERE r.target_type = :target_type AND r.target_id = :target_id
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.report_id DESC
